correctness.rationale: On the [0,1) binary shift with terminating-zero representation, applying forward doubling after either prepend branch gives FB=I. Bernoulli(α) digits are invariant under shifting and biased prepending. The stationarity identity yields F^{n+1}μ−F^nμ=r(F^nμ−F^{n−1}μ). For r≥1, uniform total variation of probabilities forces Fμ=μ and then Bμ=μ, whose cylinder probabilities uniquely determine ν_α. For r<1, the geometric forward recurrence converges in total variation to an F-invariant seed ρ and inverting (I−rB) gives the claimed affine bijection μ=(1−r)Σr^kB^kρ. Seeds λ, ν_α and δ0 produce, respectively, equivalent-AC, biased singular-continuous and countably dense purely atomic stationary laws for α≠1/2. The geometric density on length-k binary cylinders yields f=(1−r)Σ∏(2r w_d). Its independent fair-digit multipliers have E Z_k^s=M_s^k; Minkowski yields integrability for M_s<1, and positivity plus Σ Z_k^s gives divergence at equality or above. Maximal-prefix positive-measure cylinders likewise give the iff L∞ threshold. At p=8/13,α=4/5, independently calculated multipliers 1/4 and 1, giving every finite s>1 integrable yet no essential upper bound; r<1. This fully includes strict p=1/2 and α=1/2 boundaries as stated.
